reason: A bundled DSH skill for evidence-oriented GEO brand audits, combining AI-search research, competitor analysis, citation review, scoring, and report generation.

summaries.zh: 用于对品牌在多个 AI 搜索引擎中的可见性、引用、推荐、竞品表现和内容缺口进行结构化 GEO 审计。
summaries.en: A DSH skill for conducting structured GEO audits of brand visibility, citations, recommendations, competitor performance, and content gaps across AI search engines.

capabilities: Conducts structured GEO and AI-search visibility audits for a specified brand
Analyzes recommendations, citations, competitor presence, factual accuracy, and content gaps across AI search engines
Runs bundled Python validation, scoring, and report-generation scripts
Can use web search when available and process offline imported results when it is not
